method: Capabilities are promoted to CONFIRMED only after a reproducible controlled test with durable evidence. Documented primitives are distinguished from novel compositions.

confirmed.name: BCI / progressive external iteration
confirmed.summary: Ordinary ChatGPT can progressively produce, externalize, receive feedback, and revise through an external wire rather than a user-mediated ZIP loop.
confirmed.evidence_note: Established in earlier BCI benchmark runs; not re-run in this map session.

confirmed.name: Externally checkpointed cognition
confirmed.summary: A cold ChatGPT context reconstructed exact task continuation from an authoritative external pointer without prior conversation state.

confirmed.name: Context-window virtualization
confirmed.summary: Cold resumption succeeded through selective retrieval of active external state while irrelevant archived state remained unloaded.

confirmed.name: Protocol over arbitrary persistent storage
confirmed.summary: A native Google Doc served as the sole authoritative protocol/state substrate for a cold ChatGPT continuation, including deterministic selection, exact dispatch, and an appended execution receipt, without GitHub or prior task-conversation state.

confirmed.name: Cross-tool transduction
confirmed.summary: A cold ChatGPT conversation began from authoritative Google Doc state, translated it into newly authored GitHub executable artifacts, caused GitHub Actions to compute and independently verify a result, retrieved that external result, and wrote the receipt back to the original Google Doc.

confirmed.name: Ephemeral instrument factory
confirmed.summary: ChatGPT authored a purpose-built executable solver and verifier during the task and consumed the externally produced output as a new task primitive.

confirmed.name: CI compute transduction
confirmed.summary: A connected GitHub repository plus self-authored workflow became an on-demand hosted execution substrate controlled and observed from ordinary ChatGPT.

confirmed.name: Persistent multi-epoch runtime
confirmed.summary: Three separate cold ordinary ChatGPT conversations advanced one evolving externally stored runtime across three sequential epochs. Each later epoch consumed the prior epoch's externally derived state, all hosted computations and independent verifiers passed, and the final authoritative state closed as COMPLETE.

emerging_pattern: Confirmed behavior now spans cold-context state restoration, selective context virtualization, substrate-independent persistent protocols, self-authored remote execution, closed-loop transduction across unrelated systems, and coherent multi-epoch state progression across separate cold conversations. The strongest remaining architectural question is whether the same pattern can become event-driven or condition-driven without a user manually initiating each epoch.
